title: post api v1 auth register with valid patient payload
description: Test the user registration endpoint with a valid patient payload including phone_number, password, role=patient, and required profile fields. Verify that the response status is 201 Created and the response contains the user id and role.

title: post api v1 auth token with valid credentials
description: Test the token obtain endpoint with valid phone_number and password credentials. Verify that the response status is 200 OK and the response contains access and refresh JWT tokens.

title: post api v1 auth token refresh with valid refresh token
description: Test the token refresh endpoint with a valid refresh token. Verify that the response status is 200 OK and a new access token is returned.

title: post api v1 auth logout with valid access token
description: Test the logout endpoint with a valid access token in the Authorization header. Verify that the token is blacklisted and the user is logged out successfully.

title: get api v1 profile with valid access token
description: Test retrieving the user profile with a valid access token in the Authorization header. Verify that the response status is 200 OK and the user profile data is returned.

title: put api v1 profile with valid updated profile fields
description: Test updating the user profile with valid updated profile fields and a valid access token in the Authorization header. Verify that the response status is 200 OK and the profile is updated accordingly.

title: post api v1 visits estimate with valid parameters
description: Test the visit price estimation endpoint with valid latitude, longitude, and service_id parameters and a valid access token. Verify that the response status is 200 OK and the price breakdown including base_price, distance_fee, night_fee, and total is returned.

title: post api v1 visits request with valid visit details
description: Test the visit request creation endpoint with valid service_type, latitude, longitude, notes, and vitals_consent parameters and a valid access token. Verify that the response status is 201 Created and the visit id and status=PENDING are returned.

title: post api v1 visits payments webhook mock with valid payment event
description: Test the mock payment webhook endpoint with a valid payload including visit_id, payment_status, and gateway_ref. Verify that the response status is 200 OK and the transaction status is updated accordingly.
